verdict.rationale: Stripe documents machine payments for this case. Over MPP or x402, the server returns an HTTP 402 challenge, the agent presents a credential and retries, and Stripe settles the payment to the seller's balance in fiat, with no checkout UI. The docs give a per-call pricing prompt ('charge 0.50 USD per API call') and an `mppx validate` conformance CLI. Runtime probes confirm the MPP spec is published at mpp.dev and the mppx SDK is on npm. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of a completed end-to-end paid 402 call (one community comment calls the end-to-end docs sparse); true micro-pricing is limited because card/SPT payments have a 0.50 USD minimum, and stablecoin rails exclude New York.
